account.name: Skarsnik
account.bio: Warlord of da Eight Peaks. Gobbla's dad. Short but you won't say it twice.

tweets.text: reminder dat Karak Eight Peaks is MINE. not da stunties'. not da ratboyz'. mine. fanks for comin to my fred
Gobbla ate annuva stunty envoy. not sorry. dey keep sendin em
da rat wiv all da 'eads on 'is back blocked me. coward
sum personal news: I 'ave flooded da lower deeps again
dey say gobbos can't lead. I've outlived 9 orc warbosses. it's called kunnin. look it up
LOST: one prodder. sentimental value. also it's magic. if found do not touch da pointy end
It's a new night in Karak Eight Peaks.
yes, please do enlighten me. send yer messenger to da squig pit. ask for Gobbla
so glad me trap 'as been accepted into yer tunnel. me rates for takin it out again are very reasonable. a runner will bring da bill
an important principle: always charge a stunty to remove a problem you made yerself
attention all tribes: I never want to use yer squig. I want to use MY squig
